environment: Claude Code cloud container; outbound HTTPS only via the environment egress proxy (policy chosen in environment settings)
summary: All Kazakhstan official and news hosts, OSM services and even en.wikipedia.org are denied (HTTP CONNECT 403 / EGRESS_BLOCKED). No page body of any candidate source could be read in this session. Server-side WebSearch works and returns result titles, URLs and a generated summary; those are discovery hints, not source content.

websearch.returns: result link titles + URLs + model-generated summary
websearch.evidence_value: discovery only: titles are as indexed by the search engine; summaries are unreliable paraphrase; neither replaces reading the page

circumvention: Not attempted: no web archives, reader proxies or cached-page services were used for blocked hosts.
how_to_unblock: Environment settings → Network access: broader level or add these domains to Allowed domains (gov.kz, www.gov.kz, astana.gov.kz, data.egov.kz, inform.kz, www.inform.kz, kazinform.kz, vechastana.kz, astana-akshamy.kz, tengrinews.kz, kapital.kz). See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/cloud-environments#network-access. A new session may be needed for the change to apply.
